title: Very Disapointed
text:
Very Disapointed. I expected this Colander to be of top quality!
Wow was I wrong!
This comes from China, it didn't sit stright, it wobble on the counter.
The pattern wasn't even put on even!
I do think it has that good looking Villeroy & Boch pattern.
I did plan on useing this, but it was smaller then what I thought, and not very practical, but not sitting stright,and the pattern was uneven, I did return this.
Maybe nobody else would notice that, if you just wanted to put in some apples, or bannans!
but I thought it look cheap.
I was very disapointed, I expected more from Villeroy & Boch.

product_metadata.title: Villeroy & Boch French Garden Kitchen Strainer
features: 2-Quart colander ideal for draining pasta, washing greens, or displaying fruit
Made of heavy guage carbon steel with a durable enamel finish
Not recommended for use in dishwasher
description: This most popular pattern in casual dinnerware evokes a country fresh feel in this sunny and uplifting design. Creamy shades of buttery yellow and serene celadon unite the four decorated porcelain patterns in the collection. These colorful and provincial designs of fruits, lattice and flowers bring the allure of a french garden right into your home. As in all Villeroy & Boch dinnerware, French Garden is underglazed to give a soft and velvety feeling to the pieces and ensure many years of lasting beauty and durability. In addition, it is chip resistant, dishwasher, oven and microwave safe.

Designed to evoke the charm of a French garden, the Fleurence pattern from Villeroy & Boch captures the relaxed contentment found in the French countryside. Clusters of fruit and cherry blossoms, laurel leaf rings in deep green, and bands of soft country yellow and pale celadon all combine to bring the airy garden feel inside. Subtle ridges, textured layers, and other sculptural elements add a touch of sophistication, enabling the collection to be used daily or for special occasions.

A wonderful addition to the kitchen, this 2-quart enamel colander is perfect for draining pasta, washing greens, or displaying fruit. Lemons, cherries, plums, and apples decorate the outer bowl, while a band of soft country yellow, and a ring of laurel leaves, encircle the bowl and pedestal base. Standing 11 inches in diameter, including the handles, and 5-1/4 inches tall, this colander will not take up too much space in the cupboard. For best results, Villeroy & Boch recommends washing by hand.
